In 2018, she was the subject of the documentary Io sono Valentina Nappi ("I am Valentina Nappi").
In 2024, she starred in the Amazon Prime Video romantic comedy film Still Fabulous, directed by Michela Andreozzi.
She later returned for the sequel Still Sexy, released in 2026.

In September 2020, she married Giovanni Lagnese, her life partner since 2009.
